unchanged_bound_files_note: All other 12 code files and B_BINDINGS.json frozen input unchanged; smoke_bw.py is a test harness, not a bound code file.

responses.detail: Added persist_and_reload(out, sk, weight_id, tensors, device): torch.save real fitted tensors per site|weight to output/params/{sk}__{weight_id}.pt, then torch.load(weights_only=True) and verify byte-identical round-trip (torch.equal per tensor + key set). Q1 persists alpha_Q1 (FP32) and A_q1_f32 (FP32 operator); ICC persists icc_fc1_left/right and icc_fc2_left/right (BF16 factors) for BOTH weights (W_D reused landed factors, W_O fresh ordinary-SVD). Per handoff A6 the RELOADED tensors are used for final DEV scoring (not transient tensors). PARAMS_MANIFEST.json[sk|weight].params_file records path/bytes/sha256/weights_only_reloadable/tensor shapes+dtypes; Q1.alpha_Q1_sha256 (per-cell fit_sha) is now computed from the reloaded alpha_Q1, so fit_sha is verifiable against the persisted artifact. SUMMARY.json adds params_total_bytes and params_reload_verified. No norm/hash-only parameter path remains.

cell_row now takes row_indices_sha; run() loads the frozen B_BINDINGS.json (hash-verified against scope.frozen_inputs_sha256), asserts panel.count==512, and populates row_indices_sha from bindings.panel.per_source[src].token_id_sha256_le_int64 for every Q1/ICC DEV cell. Full B6 row identity now explicit in BW_CELL.csv.

BW_COST.csv now reports all five spec tasks.BW.cost_fields: parameter_bytes_per_site (Q1 alpha+A_q1_f32), factor_bytes_per_site (ICC BF16 factors), cache_bytes_per_token (units label corrected from per_site), analytic_mac_per_token, selector_packing_cost (Chip rms_score+selection(K=5120)+packed_pregate, BLOCKED this scope; Q1/ICC none), and actual_compute_consumption (shared_run_elapsed_seconds; explicitly not native full-M latency). cost_contract unchanged: IDENTICAL_WITHIN_METHOD_ACROSS_WEIGHTS;CROSS_METHOD_COST_REPORTED_NOT_MATCHED.

Soft termination is implemented via job.sh --signal=B:TERM@60 (SIGTERM at 10740s -> TimeoutError -> EXIT.json receipt), strictly below wall_seconds=10800. Safety holds; declared soft_seconds=10500 is a conservative budget label. No code change required.

smoke_bw.py comment corrected: W_D recomputed y1 need NOT bit-match bank Y_pre_gate (full-M 31668-row capture sliced to 512 vs 512-row GEMM, BF16 accumulation differs by M, spec B3). False is EXPECTED.
Runner comment corrected to 'score Q1 + ICC on DEV (primary main table, B6 DEV-only 264 cells)'; no CAL diagnostic claimed.

Added explicit ICC factor shape assert ((13824,512),(512,5120),(5120,512),(512,13824)) for both W_D (plus BF16 dtype assert) and W_O fresh factors, hardening the cross-weight ordinary-SVD r512 identity gate.

smoke_rerun: BW smoke re-run on a GPU compute node exercising the FORMAL runner.persist_and_reload real path (persist->reload->score) for both W_D and W_O; result recorded in ROOT_SELF_AUDIT.txt section 9.
